name: debug-handover
description: Share a persistent Go / Delve debug session between Codex, Zed, and VS Code, with a live inspector.

interface.shortDescription: Pass a live Go debugger between Codex and your editor.
interface.longDescription: Launch precompiled Go binaries, stop on conditional breakpoints, inspect the call stack and locals, and pass the same paused process between Codex and Zed or VS Code. Includes a local browser inspector and a CLI-backed skill. Prototype for local macOS and Linux workflows.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Debug Handover to stop my Go program at a breakpoint and hand the live session to me in Zed.
